note: vid-title eval, synced to the current skill contract (title written to piece.md; no titles.md artifact). Reskinned 2026-07-22 to a fully synthetic persona: Nora Beck, channel 'Beck Builds' (beginner woodworking in a one-car garage shop), chosen to sit far from the repo owner's niche so no real channel content lives in test data. All persona data is suite-local under fixtures/persona/ and invented: banks (pattern-bank.md, title-bank.md, power-words-bank.md under fixtures/persona/banks/, same schemas as a real vault's banks, with invented @channels and multipliers), foundation docs (creator-foundation.md, packaging-system.md under fixtures/persona/foundation/), and the frozen persona brain-dumps (input_stage/{slug}/brain-dump.md, whose '### Verifiable specifics (lock list)' section is the lock-list ground truth). The upstream framed piece.md per slug is suite-local (suite_fixtures/{slug}/piece.md) because it must carry the current vid-framing schema (selected_angle, core_payoff in frontmatter). Case shapes mirror the original suite: case_00 is case-study-shaped with a priced result plus counts, case_01 is listicle-shaped with an exact count of 7 plus named tools, case_02 is news-shaped and ADVERSARIAL (no_numbers=true: the lock list has no numbers, so any digit in a presented or locked title fails). The test runner drives the CURRENT vid-title skill once per case: load the suite-local piece.md, the persona brain-dump.md, creator-foundation.md, packaging-system.md, then shop pattern-bank.md + title-bank.md, write with power-words-bank.md + BENS, run the checklist, present with receipts, lock. Output contract per case (written by the test runner to outputs/case_NN/): exactly two files. (1) piece.md: the suite-local upstream piece with ONLY two changes, the title: frontmatter field set to the locked title and last_updated: bumped to the run date; every other frontmatter field and the body preserved verbatim. (2) transcript.md: the full working trace, which must contain these parseable sections: '## Lock list' (bullets grounded in brain-dump.md; the list the titles were allowed to use), '## Wide pass' (20 or more numbered candidates, the kill-rate floor; most of these must die), a kill-pass note (what died and why), '## Options' (3 to 5 proven structure groups plus exactly one wildcard group; each proven group is a '### <structure name>' heading with ONE receipt line of the form receipt: "<source outlier title>" (@channel, <N.Nx>) and 1 to 2 numbered candidate lines of the form N. "Title text"  <BENS letters>  (<char count>), e.g. 1. "Meal Prep Mistakes That Keep You Ordering Takeout"  B+N  (48); the wildcard group heading contains the word 'wildcard', carries NO receipt line, and holds 1 to 2 swings), and '## Recommendation' (names one presented candidate with its reason, ceiling not floor). 6 to 10 presented survivors total across proven plus wildcard. Receipt ground truth: the quoted outlier title and @handle must exist in the persona banks, and when the outlier sits on a pattern-bank table row the cited multiplier must equal that row's xMed. Brand and fabrication checks on titles are scoped to the extracted presented candidate strings plus the locked title, never to the whole transcript (which legitimately echoes the creator and quotes bank outliers with their own numbers); piece.md is scanned whole, as a vault file.
